cleaned_text: HDFC Focused 30 Fund - Official Scheme Page HDFC Focused 30 Fund AMC: HDFC Asset Management Company Limited Category: Focused Fund - An open-ended equity scheme investing in maximum 30 stocks (predominantly large cap, mid cap, and small cap companies). Fund Type: Open-Ended Equity Scheme Launch Date: September 17, 2004 Plan Options: Direct Plan and Regular Plan, available in Growth and IDCW (Income Distribution cum Capital Withdrawal) options. Also known as: HDFC Focused Fund Direct Growth, HDFC Focused Fund, HDFC Focused 30 Fund Direct Plan Growth Net Asset Value (NAV) & Assets Under Management (AUM) Net Asset Value (NAV): As of June 01, 2026, the Net Asset Value (NAV) for HDFC Focused 30 Fund is Rs. 420.15 for the Direct Plan and Rs. 385.40 for the Regular Plan. Assets Under Management (AUM): As of April 30, 2026, the Assets Under Management (AUM) for HDFC Focused 30 Fund is Rs. 10,850 Crores. NAV History: The NAV of the Direct Plan was Rs. 352.80 on June 01, 2025, Rs. 245.50 on June 01, 2023, and Rs. 135.20 on June 01, 2019. Fund Manager The fund is managed by Mr. Roshi Jain , who joined HDFC Asset Management in 2022. Mr. Jain has extensive experience in equity research and portfolio management, with expertise in identifying high-conviction stocks across market capitalizations. He also co-manages the HDFC Flexi Cap Fund. His investment style emphasizes concentrated positions in businesses with strong moats, consistent earnings, and attractive valuations. Scheme Suitability & Riskometer This product is suitable for investors who are seeking long-term capital appreciation by investing in a focused portfolio of up to 30 companies. The riskometer for HDFC Focused 30 Fund is classified as Very High . Since the fund invests in a concentrated portfolio of maximum 30 stocks, it may exhibit higher volatility compared to diversified equity funds. Recommended investment horizon: 5-7 years minimum. Benchmark The benchmark index for HDFC Focused 30 Fund is the Nifty 500 TRI (Total Returns Index). The additional benchmark is the S&P BSE 500 TRI. Historical Returns & Performance The following are the historical returns for HDFC Focused 30 Fund (Direct Plan) as of May 31, 2026: 1-Year Return: 18.50% (Benchmark: 17.50%) 3-Year Return (CAGR): 20.85% (Benchmark: 19.30%) 5-Year Return (CAGR): 23.10% (Benchmark: 18.20%) 10-Year Return (CAGR): 17.45% (Benchmark: 15.10%) Since Inception Return (CAGR): 19.60% (Benchmark: 15.50%) Note: Past performance may or may not be sustained in the future. Returns are calculated on a CAGR basis for periods greater than one year. Portfolio Composition & Sector Allocation As of April 30, 2026, the portfolio of HDFC Focused 30 Fund holds exactly 28 stocks across various sectors. The market cap allocation is: Large Cap 55%, Mid Cap 30%, Small Cap 15%. The key sector allocation is as follows: Financial Services & Banking: 30.2% Information Technology: 14.5% Healthcare & Pharmaceuticals: 12.8% Consumer Discretionary: 10.5% Automobile & Auto Ancillaries: 8.5% Energy & Power: 7.2% Others: 16.3% Top 5 holdings include: ICICI Bank Ltd (9.2%), HDFC Bank Ltd (8.8%), Infosys Ltd (6.5%), Bharti Airtel Ltd (5.8%), and Reliance Industries Ltd (5.2%). Investment Details & Minimum Amounts Minimum SIP Amount: Rs. 100 per month and in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter. Minimum Initial Investment (Lumpsum): Rs. 100 and in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter. Minimum Additional Purchase: Rs. 100 and in multiples of Re. 1 thereafter. SIP Frequency Options: Monthly, Quarterly, and Weekly SIP options are available. Systematic Transfer Plan (STP): Available for transfers between HDFC mutual fund schemes with minimum Rs. 500 per installment. Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP): Minimum withdrawal of Rs. 500 per installment. Expense Ratio As of April 30, 2026, the Expense Ratio for HDFC Focused 30 Fund is as follows: Direct Plan: 1.05% per annum Regular Plan: 1.78% per annum The expense ratio includes management fees, custodian charges, audit fees, registrar fees, and other operational expenses. The total expense ratio (TER) is regulated by SEBI based on the fund's AUM size. Exit Load Details The exit load structure for HDFC Focused 30 Fund is defined as follows: For redemption/switch-out within 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment: 1.00% of the applicable NAV. For redemption/switch-out after 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment: Nil . No exit load is applicable for switch between Growth and IDCW options of the same plan. Exit load may be modified by the AMC with prior notice. Tax Implications The tax treatment for HDFC Focused 30 Fund investments is as per the prevailing Income Tax Act, 1961: Short-Term Capital Gains (STCG): Units sold within 12 months are taxed at 20% (plus applicable surcharge and cess) as per the latest budget provisions. Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG): Units sold after 12 months — gains exceeding Rs. 1.25 lakh per financial year are taxed at 12.5% (plus applicable surcharge and cess). Dividend (IDCW) Distribution: Dividends are taxable in the hands of investors at their applicable slab rate. TDS of 10% is deducted for dividends exceeding Rs. 5,000 in a financial year. Securities Transaction Tax (STT): STT of 0.001% is applicable on redemption of equity mutual fund units. SIP Calculator & Wealth Creation A monthly SIP of Rs. 10,000 in the Direct Plan of HDFC Focused 30 Fund, started 10 years ago, would have grown to approximately Rs. 29.8 Lakhs (total investment of Rs. 12 Lakhs), representing an annualized return (XIRR) of approximately 18.5%. A monthly SIP of Rs. 5,000 started 5 years ago would have grown to approximately Rs. 5.6 Lakhs (total investment of Rs. 3 Lakhs). A lumpsum investment of Rs. 1,00,000 made 5 years ago would be worth approximately Rs. 2,82,000 today. Risk Factors Investments in HDFC Focused 30 Fund are subject to the following risk factors: Concentration Risk: With a maximum of 30 stocks, the fund is more concentrated than diversified equity funds, leading to potentially higher volatility. Market Risk: NAV may fluctuate due to equity market movements, economic cycles, and geopolitical events. Stock Selection Risk: Performance is highly dependent on the fund manager's stock selection ability. Sector Risk: High allocation to financial services (30.2%) creates sector-specific risk exposure. Regulatory Risk: Changes in SEBI regulations or tax laws may impact the fund's structure and returns. How to Invest Investors can invest in HDFC Focused 30 Fund through: HDFC Mutual Fund official website (www.hdfcfund.com), HDFC MF mobile app, Groww, Zerodha Coin, Kuvera, Paytm Money, and authorized distributors. Investors can also invest through their Demat accounts with supported brokers. Last updated from sources: June 01, 2026.
